The '''''Ottega Dawn''''' was an [[Ithorian Herdship]]. It shared a portion of its name with the [[Ottega (star)|primary star]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Ottega Dawn'' was [[Capture of the Ottega Dawn|captured]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who placed it at the fore of their assault force, assuming that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] would not fire upon a ship with a large number of civilian passengers and crew aboard.<ref name="TCWCG" />

While the tactic was initially successful, it backfired when the ship was retaken by a group of [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] mutineers,<ref name="TCWCG" /> which included the brothers [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]] and [[Onca/Legends|Onca]].<ref name="SWBlogGunslingers1">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
